title: Private Apt loft in the heart of Hendersonville
description:
A newly renovated large loft in the heart of Hendersonville, sitting in a safe and quiet residential neighborhood behind Indian Lake and next to Bluegrass Country Club 20 minutes from Nashville.

The loft is fully independent and next to main home, so you get complete privacy from the moment you arrive. Self check-in with Keyless entry, parking on our driveway, a new and full equipped kitchen on the first floor and coming soon crossfit type of gym.

The space
Step inside through a Parisian-style entrance with soaring high ceilings that set the tone for the rest of the space.

The one bedroom loft is thoughtfully laid out with a queen bed, a cozy sofa, and a TV, plus a dedicated dining area for meals in. The kitchen is equipped, and a brand new bath with upscale finishes and floating cabinets.

Outside, a spacious driveway to park comfortably. Do not hesitate to reach out we can try to help we local request or suggestions.

Guest access
You have full and exclusive use of the entire large loft: bedroom, kitchen, and bathroom. You are welcome to use the driveway for parking. During summer, we can arrange access to the private pool and terrace.
